content: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs), with a particular emphasis on finerenone, have demonstrated significant efficacy in mitigating the progression of kidney disease and reducing cardiovascular events in patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) who also have type 2 diabetes (T2D). Clinical trials, such as the FIDELIO-DKD study, have provided robust evidence showing that finerenone effectively decreases albuminuria levels and slows the progression of CKD. These benefits are especially pronounced in individuals with an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of ≥25 mL/min/1.73 m² and substantial albuminuria.
